tools.name: locate
tools.description: Place a Canadian postal code, FSA or lat,lng as coordinates. Free. Use it to check a location before searching.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Banners, current flyer weeks, store counts and known gaps (e.g. FreshCo store locations unknown; shelf prices No Frills only, with Statistics Canada Ontario averages as a labelled fallback). Free. Call it before telling a user something isn't on sale.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: The user's Gaurmon plan: trial days left, or the paid plan and when it renews. Free.

tools.name: stores_near
tools.description: Stores within a radius, nearest first, each with every flyer it runs this week and how many offers each flyer has.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: This week's flyer offers for item words, an aisle, or deals near a place: give at least one of `query`, `aisle` or `near`. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_savings · Private data: record_purchases, get_savings, update_list · Public sink: get_savings, get_list, update_meals · Destructive: update_list, update_meals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_savings · Private data: record_purchases, get_savings, update_list · Public sink: get_savings, get_list, update_meals · Destructive: update_list, update_meals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
